summary: Online hackathon to build AI Skills for a NAS across four tracks. Round 1 needs a proposal of up to 500 words plus a test Skill; no NAS needed to enter.
eligibility: Individuals of legal age or teams of up to 3, from countries in the official rules; organisations cannot enter; Brazil, China and Quebec excluded.
title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026: Build AI Skills for a NAS

prize.description: US$46,000 cash: 1st US$20,000, 2nd US$10,000, 3rd US$6,000, two Most Creative awards US$5,000 each.

notes: Up to 30 finalists announced 21 Nov; final Skills and demo videos due 30 Nov.
